summary: KalliTag MVP first test run. Backend: 9/9 pytest passed (products, checkout, payments/status, webhook signature). Frontend: Landing, Configurator wizard (3 steps), live preview all render/work correctly. CRITICAL bug in end-to-end checkout flow: POST /api/checkout returns 422 whenever the optional 'profile.email' field is left empty (default '' in ConfigContext) because backend Pydantic Optional[EmailStr] rejects empty strings. This blocks the whole Stripe redirect when user doesn't fill in the optional professional email.

critical.issue: Optional profile.email='' from frontend triggers Pydantic EmailStr validation error (422). ProfileConfig.email is declared Optional[EmailStr]=None but Pydantic v2 rejects empty string. Fix: add a validator to coerce '' -> None for email/EmailStr fields (or Union[EmailStr, Literal['']]=None). Blocks Stripe checkout for users who leave the optional email empty.

integration_issues.issue: startCheckout sends profile with email='' (initial value in ConfigContext.initialProfile). Backend rejects with 422. Fix at frontend: strip empty strings before POST, or default email to null. Alternatively fix on backend (preferred).

action_items: Fix ProfileConfig.email handling: accept empty string by coercing to None (backend Pydantic validator) OR sanitize payload on frontend before POST /api/checkout.
After fix: re-run UI e2e — expected Stripe checkout redirect (checkout.stripe.com) from /configurateur step 3.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: Optional[EmailStr] with default None + frontend sending '' is a common Pydantic v2 pitfall. Add @field_validator('email', mode='before') to convert '' -> None on ProfileConfig (and consider same for ShippingAddress.line2 and links values which are already str, but any future EmailStr fields).
Backend server.py is a single 400+ line file — for MVP acceptable but plan to split into routers/models/services as it grows.
Backend: stripe.error.InvalidRequestError fallback for automatic_tax is good defensive coding. OK.
Frontend ConfigContext.initialProfile.email='' should probably be null to align with backend nullable Optional fields.
Backend correctly excludes _id via projection ({'_id':0}) — good.
Webhook idempotency for _on_paid uses modified_count check — correct.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (UI + preview work; checkout redirect blocked by backend 422)

seed_data_creation: Test orders inserted in Mongo with contact_email TEST_*@example.com via checkout tests (draft status, not paid).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_kallitag.py covers products, checkout happy path, invalid inputs, webhook signature check, unknown session. After main agent fixes the ProfileConfig.email='' handling, re-run pytest and re-run the UI script to verify redirect to checkout.stripe.com from /configurateur step 3 button [data-testid=checkout-stripe-button]. Landing hero CTA testid: hero-cta-order.
rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: Backend ProfileConfig defines `email: Optional[EmailStr] = None`. In Pydantic v2, EmailStr does not accept empty string — even when Optional, passing '' triggers value_error 'must have an @-sign'. Frontend ConfigContext.initialProfile has email='' and updateProfile keeps it as '' when the user doesn't touch the field. Configurator submits the whole profile object, so POST /api/checkout receives profile.email='' and returns 422. REPRO: fill configurator step2 leaving 'Email professionnel' blank -> continue to step3 -> click Payer. MITIGATION (backend, preferred): add `@field_validator('email','logo_url', mode='before')` on ProfileConfig returning None for empty strings. OR frontend: sanitize payload with `email: cfg.profile.email || null`.
